entries.title: Psalms 144:2
segments:
My people; all the people subject to David, both Israelites and foreigners. 
 
All the success of kings and military leaders is from the Lord, and he would have them acknowledge his hand in it.

entries.title: Psalms 144:3
segments: Takest knowledge of him--makest account of him; by bestowing upon him such wonderful mercies as I have received.  Compare

entries.title: Psalms 144:4
segments: The consideration of our littleness and unworthiness enhances our view of God's wonderful loving-kindness towards us.

entries.title: Psalms 144:5
segments: Bow thy heavens; bend them aside like a curtain,
, to make way for thy descent.  The same as "rend the heavens,"

entries.title: Psalms 144:7
segments: Strange children; people of foreign nations.

entries.title: Psalms 144:8
segments:
Vanity; words destitute of righteousness and truth. 
 
  A right hand of falsehood; whose oaths, made by raising the right hand, and pledges made by striking the hand with another, are false.

entries.title: Psalms 144:9
segments: A new song; for new mercies received.

entries.title: Psalms 144:12
segments:
That our sons may be; in this and the remaining verses of this psalm he draws a beautiful picture of a peaceful and well-ordered state, such as Israel shall be when God has granted to David its king deliverance from all his foes. 
 
  Grown up; grown up strong and vigorous. 
 
The end which rulers should propose to themselves in all their undertakings, is the good of the people whom God has committed to their care.  No victory is worth gaining that has not this for its object and result.

entries.title: Psalms 144:14
segments:
Breaking in; of the enemy. 
 
  Going out; into captivity. 
 
  Complaining; literally, cry, that is, of distress. 
 
The true glory of a nation is to be measured, not by its outward conquests, but by it inward peace and prosperity.  The proper business of "kings," and of "all that are in authority," is to take care that their people "may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty."

entries.title: Psalms 144:15
segments: There is but one way for nations to be prosperous and happy; that way is, to acknowledge and obey God.
